title: Quantifying isochrone-based age uncertainties for rapidly rotating A-type stars
abstract: Investigates age and mass uncertainties from isochrone fitting for rapidly rotating A-type stars, where conventional stellar age indicators are often ineffective.

title: 200,000+ Deep Learning-inferred Periods of Stellar Variability from the All-Sky Automated Survey for Supernovae
abstract: Uses deep learning to measure variability periods in a large sample of ASAS-SN stars, enabling population-scale studies of stellar rotation and evolution.

title: New Rotation Periods from the Kepler Bonus Background Light Curves
abstract: Applies a convolutional neural network to deblended Kepler Bonus light curves, measuring rotation periods for over 32,000 sources, including thousands of new periods.

title: Model Choice Matters for Age Inference on the Red Giant Branch
abstract: Examines how stellar model selection affects red-giant age estimates, showing that model-systematic uncertainties remain important even as observational precision improves.

title: Magnetic Activity Evolution of Solar-like Stars. II. Sph-Ro Evolution of Kepler Main-sequence Targets
abstract: Combines Kepler measurements of stellar rotation and magnetic activity with interior models to investigate how activity evolves with Rossby number in main-sequence stars.

title: TESS Stellar Rotation up to 80 Days in the Southern Continuous Viewing Zone
abstract: Measures long stellar rotation periods from TESS observations in the Southern Continuous Viewing Zone, extending rotation studies to periods as long as 80 days.

title: The Importance of Neural Network Hyperparameters in Determining Age Inference Quality
abstract: Reports a study of how neural-network hyperparameter choices affect machine-learning estimates of stellar ages from a limited set of well-characterized stars.

title: Magnetic Activity Evolution of Solar-like Stars. I. Sph-Age Relation Derived from Kepler Observations
abstract: Uses Kepler observations to derive the relationship between photometric magnetic activity and age for solar-like stars.

title: The TIME Table: rotation and ages of cool exoplanet host stars
abstract: Presents rotation periods and gyrochronological ages for cool exoplanet-host stars, supporting age estimates for planet populations around M dwarfs.

title: Recovery of TESS Stellar Rotation Periods Using Deep Learning
abstract: Trains a convolutional neural network on realistic simulated light curves and applies it to TESS observations to recover stellar rotation periods.

title: A Guide to Realistic Uncertainties on the Fundamental Properties of Solar-type Exoplanet Host Stars
abstract: Discusses realistic uncertainties in fundamental stellar parameters for solar-type exoplanet hosts, important for interpreting exoplanet properties and demographics.

title: The Second Discovery from the COCONUTS Program: A Cold Wide-orbit Exoplanet around a Young Field M Dwarf at 10.9 pc
abstract: Reports COCONUTS-2, a cold brown-dwarf companion on a wide orbit around a nearby young M dwarf, identified through common motion and parallax.

title: Chemical Evolution in the Milky Way: Rotation-based Ages for APOGEE-Kepler Cool Dwarf Stars
abstract: Uses stellar angular-momentum evolution models to estimate ages for about 500 cool dwarfs and compare their age distributions with Galactic chemical-evolution trends.

title: Butterpy: Stellar butterfly diagram and rotational light curve simulator
abstract: Describes butterpy, a software package for simulating starspot emergence and evolution, stellar butterfly diagrams, and rotational light curves.

title: kiauhoku: Stellar model grid interpolation
abstract: Describes kiauhoku, a tool for manipulating and interpolating stellar evolutionary model grids, including YREC, MIST, Dartmouth, and GARSTEC.
